details.playable: Open the game: title shows name and tagline; New Game shows the written preface; top bar shows the goal line.
details.try: Launch, press New Game, read the preface, press Begin.
details.generated_data_exception: tools/build_story.py is the only writer of data/story_text.json (145 entries) and data/events.json (16 events, choices empty until T74 writes choice events); text-only exception to the data/ rule.
details.api: StoryText.get_text(id, args) in game/story_text.gd. Named get_text because Object already defines get(). Missing id logs an error and returns the id.
details.builder_conventions: Ending max from id: _EPI 140, BARE 350, _FULL_ 1000, END_LOSS 600, else 700. END_BTN_* have 3 fields and no text line: third field read as the label. Skill ids A1..C4 become SK_<id>_NAME/_FLAVOUR/_PLAIN.
